name: dealhound
description: Help choose physical products within your budget, compare options and check retailer offers using your agent’s browsing tools.

interface.longDescription: Choose your next purchase with less searching. Tell DealHound what you need, your budget and buying country. Your agent researches physical products with its available browsing tools, compares options against your needs and checks retailer offers before describing a price as current. Not sure what to look for? Ask for ideas based on interests you have shared, then confirm what you want to explore. DealHound prepares convenient Amazon.com product links for suitable finds. Amazon.com is currently the supported affiliate merchant; other retailers may appear as clearly labeled alternatives. Current prices, stock, shipping and offer conditions must be checked at the retailer. Unverified offers are labeled; savings are not guaranteed. Qualifying purchases through affiliate links may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you. Searches happen when you ask. DealHound does not place orders, save a shopping profile or monitor prices in the background.
defaultPrompt: Find me deals on some stuff I’m interested in. Ask what to focus on and my budget.
Help me choose a compact MIDI controller under $100 for shopping in the US.
Compare quiet mechanical keyboards under $100 for shopping in the US.

publication.release_notes: Clarified shopping-intent discovery, added budget-focused starter prompts and explicit skill activation boundaries. Affiliate linking and live-offer verification requirements remain unchanged.
